fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-08-02, the father of the complainant, Jothi Selvi, aged 81, left home for a temple visit and had not returned; last seen near Poongodi Layout Residential Colony in Tiruppur. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-08-02 at approximately 17:25. The complaint was lodged by Gunasekar Murugan (9000000210), a family member of Jothi Selvi, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000436. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. The complaint refers to Sanjay Mani, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000120. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Person last seen near a bus stop and could not be traced afterwards.
fields.Keywords: missing person, elderly, associate, evening, CCTV, photograph, residential colony
